snp2.1:1.1: Whatever beings have come together here,
snp2.1:1.2: whether of the earth or in the firmament,
snp2.1:1.3: may the minds of all those beings be happy,
snp2.1:1.4: and may they listen carefully to what is said.
snp2.1:2.1: Therefore, all of you beings, be attentive,
snp2.1:2.2: be friendly towards this generation of men,
snp2.1:2.3: they who bring offerings by day and by night,
snp2.1:2.4: therefore, being heedful, you must protect them.
snp2.1:3.1: Whatever riches there are - here or elsewhere
snp2.1:3.2: or in the heavens - that excellent treasure
snp2.1:3.3: is not equal unto the Realised One,
snp2.1:3.4: this excellent treasure is in the Buddha:
snp2.1:3.5: by virtue of this truth may there be safety!
snp2.1:4.2: which the concentrated Sakyan sage attained,
snp2.1:4.3: there is nothing that is equal to that state,
snp2.1:4.4: this excellent treasure is in the Dhamma:
snp2.1:4.5: by virtue of this truth may there be safety!
snp2.1:5.1: That which the Buddha, the Great One, praised as pure,
snp2.1:5.2: the concentration said to have prompt (result),
snp2.1:5.3: no equal to that concentration is found,
snp2.1:5.4: this excellent treasure is in the Dhamma:
snp2.1:5.5: by virtue of this truth may there be safety!
snp2.1:6.1: Those eight individuals praised by the good,
snp2.1:6.2: there are these four pairs (of individuals),
snp2.1:6.3: those disciples of the Happy One are worthy of gifts,
snp2.1:6.4: those things that have been given to them have great fruits,
snp2.1:6.5: this excellent treasure is in the Saṅgha:
snp2.1:6.6: by virtue of this truth may there be safety!
snp2.1:7.1: Those who have firm and devoted minds,
snp2.1:7.2: without sense desire in Gotama's dispensation,
snp2.1:7.3: those who have attained, and entered the deathless,
snp2.1:7.4: are enjoying emancipation, gained for free,
snp2.1:7.5: this excellent treasure is in the Saṅgha:
snp2.1:7.6: by virtue of this truth may there be safety!
snp2.1:8.1: Just as a locking post stuck fast in the earth
snp2.1:8.2: does not waver on account of the four winds,
snp2.1:8.3: in the same way, I say, is the true person,
snp2.1:8.4: the one who sees the noble truths completely,
snp2.1:8.5: this excellent treasure is in the Saṅgha:
snp2.1:8.6: by virtue of this truth may there be safety!
snp2.1:9.1: Those who clearly distinguish the noble truths,
snp2.1:9.2: which were well preached by the one with deep wisdom,
snp2.1:9.3: however great they become in heedlessness
snp2.1:9.4: still they do not take up an eighth existence,
snp2.1:9.5: this excellent treasure is in the Saṅgha:
snp2.1:9.6: by virtue of this truth may there be safety!
snp2.1:10.2: there are a triad of things that are given up:
snp2.1:10.4: and whatever (grasping at) virtue and practices there is.
snp2.1:11.1: He is free from (rebirth in) the four lower worlds,
snp2.1:11.2: he is incapable of the six great crimes.
snp2.1:11.3: this excellent treasure is in the Saṅgha:
snp2.1:11.4: by virtue of this truth may there be safety!
snp2.1:12.1: Whatever bad action there is that he performs
snp2.1:12.2: by way of body, or of speech, or of mind,
snp2.1:12.3: he is incapable of covering it up,
snp2.1:12.4: this incapacity is said of one who has seen the state (of peace),
snp2.1:12.5: this excellent treasure is in the Saṅgha:
snp2.1:12.6: by virtue of this truth may there be safety!
snp2.1:13.1: Just like a tall woodland tree crowned with blossom
snp2.1:13.2: in the summer months, in the early summer,
snp2.1:13.3: in the same way he preached the Dhamma which is best,
snp2.1:13.4: which goes to Nibbāna, the highest benefit,
snp2.1:13.5: this excellent treasure is in the Buddha:
snp2.1:13.6: by virtue of this truth may there be safety!
snp2.1:14.1: The best one, knowing the best, giving the best, brought the best,
snp2.1:14.2: brought the best, unsurpassed he preached the best Dhamma.
snp2.1:14.3: this excellent treasure is in the Buddha:
snp2.1:14.4: by virtue of this truth may there be safety!
snp2.1:15.1: The old is destroyed, and nothing new is produced,
snp2.1:15.2: (their) minds are unexcited by future rebirth,
snp2.1:15.3: they have destroyed the seeds, and have no desire for growth,
snp2.1:15.4: the wise are still, just as this lamp (is still),
snp2.1:15.5: this excellent treasure is in the Saṅgha:
snp2.1:15.6: by virtue of this truth may there be safety!
snp2.1:16.1: Whatever beings have come together here,
snp2.1:16.2: whether of the earth or in the firmament,
snp2.1:16.3: the Realised One is revered by gods and men,
snp2.1:16.4: we honour the Buddha - may there be safety!
snp2.1:17.1: Whatever beings have come together here,
snp2.1:17.2: whether of the earth or in the firmament,
snp2.1:17.3: the Realised One is revered by gods and men,
snp2.1:17.4: we honour the Dhamma - may there be safety!
snp2.1:18.1: Whatever beings have come together here,
snp2.1:18.2: whether of the earth or in the firmament,
snp2.1:18.3: the Realised One is revered by gods and men,
snp2.1:18.4: we honour the Saṅgha - may there be safety!
